source: Basic Manglik / Kuja / Mangal Dosha PRESENCE check per the classical Parashari convention: Mars placed in specific houses from a reference point flags the dosha, UNLESS Mars itself is strong enough that it cannot inflict the dosha. This v1.2 rule set is fixed by the app spec (docs/spec.md and the user's Milestone brief) as: three reference points (Lagna, Moon, Venus), six trigger houses (1, 2, 4, 7, 8, 12), Anshik / Full grading by triggered-reference count, PLUS Mars-strength cancellations (own sign / exalted / debilitated). The specific cell values are cited in Parashari, B. V. Raman's 'Muhurtha' and are the same convention Drik Panchang applies.
houseSystemNote: Whole-sign house math: house = ((grahaRashi - refRashi + 12) % 12) + 1. Uses only the sidereal longitudes stored on birth_charts (ascendantLongitude, marsLongitude, venusLongitude, moonRashiNumber). No Placidus cusp dependency, no additional ephemeris call at match time.
referencePointsNote: 'LAGNA' is the Ascendant. 'MOON' is Chandra Lagna (Mars house counted from the Moon's sign). 'VENUS' is Shukra Lagna (Mars house counted from Venus's sign).
triggerHousesNote: The classical Kuja Dosha houses. Some traditions treat house 2 or 8 differently (mild/severe); v1 treats all six identically. Advanced strength-based grading of individual houses is out of scope.
gradingNote: 'Anshik Manglik' (अंशिक मंगल दोष) — presence from exactly one of the three reference points is treated as partial; presence from two or three is full Manglik. Common Indian marriage-matching convention. This grading applies AFTER any cancellation below has been considered.

byMarsSign.note: Mars in its own sign (Aries or Scorpio) — Mars is strong and does not inflict Manglik dosha. Classical rule cited in Parashari and B. V. Raman's 'Muhurtha'.
Mars exalted in Capricorn — Mars is at maximum strength and does not inflict Manglik dosha.
Mars debilitated in Cancer — Mars loses the power to inflict Manglik dosha. Widely cited alongside the own-sign/exaltation cancellations.

cancellationsNote: Mars-strength cancellations only. If Mars is in one of the four listed signs (Aries, Scorpio, Capricorn, Cancer), the person is NOT Manglik regardless of how many reference points would otherwise trigger. The raw per-reference marsHouse and 'present' fields are still reported for transparency; the overall status is NOT_MANGLIK and 'cancellations' carries the specific cancellation code. Advanced cancellations (age-based, aspect-based, benefic-aspect-on-Mars, Manglik-Manglik nullification, dosha-bhanga yogas) remain OUT OF SCOPE — the app must still not automatically declare a Manglik-Manglik or Anshik-Anshik match safe.
statusesNote: v1.0 emitted only NOT_MANGLIK / MANGLIK. v1.1 added PARTIAL_MANGLIK via the grading rule. v1.2 adds Mars-strength cancellations that can override any grade to NOT_MANGLIK (with the specific cancellation code populated on the status). Historical results retain their producing ruleVersion on the MatchRecord.
